title: Fix Puzzle 3D Suggest Object Context Menu Finalize and Empty List
description:
puzzle 3d: There are several problems with suggest object over context menu:
- Sometimes it doesnt finalize the option that was chosen
- Sometimes it when clicking suggest objects on context menu no list appears (not even when there are plenty of objects, retrying sometimes works)
summary:
Fixed intermittent Puzzle 3D context-menu "Suggest objects" empty list and failed finalize.

Root causes:
1. Split top/perspective panes each mounted a suggestion ContextMenuController; sibling outside-pointerdown handlers treated the other menu as outside and fired closeVortexSuggestions on pointerdown, often before acceptSuggestion's click.
2. Selecting a suggestion always auto-closed via closeVortexSuggestions in parallel with accept.
3. Opening could reuse a stale empty brush-candidate cache, so the popup showed no usable candidates until a later retry.

Fixes:
- ContextMenuController: ignore dismiss when the event targets any [role=menu]; arm outside-dismiss after 0ms; closeOnSelect=false for the suggestion popup.
- Render the suggestion menu only for the opening windowId.
- openVortexSuggestions invalidates+refreshes brush candidates; menu carries windowId + vortexFullId.
- acceptSuggestion accepts fullId, rebinds selection, refreshes candidates, then places.

Verified: cargo puzzle-plugin suggestion filter (7 passed); vitest ContextMenu sibling/closeOnSelect/isContextMenuPointerTarget (4 passed).
